Routes an order of the owner (typed, or from `/transcribe`): rules first
(company, role and keyword names), then the light model, then the advisor
only when it is still ambiguous. work -> the CEO or, when a department is
named, its manager (the shortcut); code -> a running session of the
workspace, else a new session under a live grant, else a `code_session`
decision; question -> the advisor (thread A); meeting -> a work item for
the CEO. What agents and models read is masked. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.

directly: a `hire` decision proposed **and** sealed by the owner in one
transaction (approved, resolution M-…), then the employee. The same checks
as an agent's proposal (the charter `role` must fit the company and the
department); `model`, `effort` and `title_en` default to the charter's.

pending hire card is withdrawn (never deleted; listed in `withdrawn`).

the owner decides every card, and each CEO (and each holding head with a
hiring duty) gets one work item "propose your first month's team" (a second
start adds none). `delegated` (each CEO hires inside its monthly envelope)
answers `409 not_ready` until prompt 8, before any step-up is consumed and
without changing anything. Honours `Idempotency-Key` (a retry after a lost
answer gets the same answer, not a spent step-up).

or a new version of it: its transport (`http` through the egress proxy;
`container` on the internal network hq-mcp), the tools with their class
and the companies that may call it. Pending until `/enable`. The secret is
written on the server (`make mcp-secret KEY=…`), never through the API.
Switches a server off at once (no step-up: stopping is always allowed).

listing on its next call; a later change switches it off again.

(`file_id`); attach it to a message and the message is a voice transcript.

attention quota apply. An agent's 🔴 needs an incident `category` and is

The gateway reserves one tool call of the token's run before it acts: the

out to the owner's GET /api/v1/threads/{code}/live. Never stored, never on
NATS, never logged; the final text is the stored message.
An agent replies in a thread it belongs to. Requires `Idempotency-Key`.
